stable_traits.physical_traits: red hair, gray eyes, tall, light skin under sun-exposed areas
stable_traits.filiations: son of Tam al'Thor (shepherd/farmer); mother was an outlander
stable_traits.personality: stubborn, honest but learning to conceal truth when threatened, feels guilt about admiring other women while Egwene is away

characters.notes: Repeatedly compared to an Aielman in appearance by Gawyn; Elaida questions his claim to be from Two Rivers based on his looks. Bears a heron-mark sword. Central to Elaida's Foretelling.

stable_traits.physical_traits: red-gold curls, blue eyes, tall for a girl, beautiful with oval face and full red lips, younger than Rand by 2-3 years
stable_traits.filiations: Daughter-Heir to throne of Andor; daughter of Morgase; sister of Gawyn; half-sister of Galad (same father Taringail Damodred)
stable_traits.personality: self-possessed, confident, expects obedience, kind-hearted (rescues strays), defiant of restrictions, curious

aliases_observed.notes: how she is addressed by guards and others

characters.notes: Wears elaborate clothing including silver filigree circlet, silver rings, emerald necklace, velvet cloak with silver bells. Carries medical supplies in cloak pockets. Treats Rand's wounds. Due to go to Tar Valon for training.

stable_traits.physical_traits: head taller than Elayne, face and hair mark him as her close kin, older than Elayne
stable_traits.age: about Rand's age, older than Elayne
stable_traits.filiations: son of Morgase; brother of Elayne; half-brother of Galad (same father Taringail Damodred); will be First Prince of the Sword
stable_traits.personality: protective of Elayne, loyal, obedient to mother and sister, affectionate toward Elayne despite her bossiness

factions.name: House Trakand
factions.notes: Future First Prince of the Sword

characters.notes: Wears ornate red, white, and gold clothing. Training to be First Prince of the Sword. His life has been saved twice by Galad.

stable_traits.physical_traits: beautiful, mature version of Elayne's beauty; wears Rose Crown of Andor, Great Serpent ring
stable_traits.filiations: Queen of Andor; mother of Elayne and Gawyn; widow of Taringail Damodred
stable_traits.personality: strong-willed, just, has a temper, cares about upholding justice even under pressure, maternal toward children

factions.name: House Trakand
factions.notes: Queen of Andor, High Seat of House Trakand

aliases_observed.alias_text: Morgase, by the Grace of the Light, Queen of Andor, Defender of the Realm, Protector of the People, High Seat of the House Trakand

characters.notes: Wears red and white pleated silk dress with Lion of Andor stole. Considering marriage to Gareth Bryne but neither will bend first. Decides to free Rand based on justice and her assessment of his truthfulness.

stable_traits.physical_traits: ageless Aes Sedai appearance, handsome, sits knitting dark wool
stable_traits.filiations: Aes Sedai advisor to Queen Morgase
stable_traits.personality: stern beyond Moiraine, calculating, hungry for knowledge/power, appears placid but has terrible concentration, does not lie but wraps truth in mystery

characters.notes: Has the Talent of Foretelling; predicts pain and division for Andor and the world, with Rand at the heart of it. Made the Palace gardens green when crops fail elsewhere. Dislikes rats—Palace has none. Suspicious of Rand, wants him imprisoned. Her stare freezes Rand. Will take Elayne to Tar Valon for training.

stable_traits.physical_traits: bluff, blocky man; temples heavy with gray; looks strong and immovable as a rock
stable_traits.filiations: served three Queens; was First Prince Regent for two Queens
stable_traits.personality: observant, notices everything, fair-minded, practical, symbol of continuity and stability in Andor

aliases_observed.notes: used familiarly by Morgase and royals

characters.notes: Wears red uniform with four golden knots on shoulder and wide golden bands on cuffs. Morgase wants to marry him but neither will bend first. Recognizes that Rand's sword belongs with him despite his youth. Advises temporary imprisonment but accepts Queen's judgment.

stable_traits.physical_traits: young officer with face behind barred faceguard
stable_traits.personality: dutiful, has had to accept Elayne's commands before and resents it, takes satisfaction when he has proper authority to resist her, scowls at perceived disrespect

characters.notes: Wears golden knot of an officer on shoulder. Led the arrest of Rand. Sourly obeys order to escort Rand with courtesy. Slams sally-port after Rand leaves.

stable_traits.physical_traits: handsomest man Rand had ever seen, almost too handsome for masculinity, tall and slender, dark hair and eyes, movements speak of whipcord strength and confidence
stable_traits.age: young adult, older than Elayne and Gawyn
stable_traits.filiations: son of Taringail Damodred; half-brother to Elayne and Gawyn (same father, different mother)
stable_traits.personality: always does the right thing even when he should not, does not know envy, honorable, has saved Gawyn's life twice when he could have let him die to become First Prince

characters.notes: Wears red, white, and gold clothing, ornate and brocaded. Elayne hates him, calls him vile and full of envy (though Gawyn says Galad does not know envy). Reported Rand to guards as 'the right thing.' Well thought of by wearers of red and white. Could have been First Prince of the Sword if Gawyn died.
Being brought through Caemlyn on way to Tar Valon. Morgase wishes he had never come near Caemlyn. Guarded by Aes Sedai constantly. Rand and others climbed walls to see him pass.
Appears in Rand's dream at the beginning of the chapter, sitting at table where Moiraine and Logain had been.

stable_traits.age: older (was nurse when Elayne was little)
stable_traits.personality: strict, able to make Elayne obey, switched Elayne for stealing figs

characters.notes: Mentioned as one of the few people Elayne cannot give orders to. Morgase jokes about sending Lini to Tar Valon to keep Elayne in line.
The only cat Rand sees in the Palace. Gawyn mentions 'Elaida doesn't like rats' and 'We never have rats.' Strikes Rand as odd that there are no other cats.

appearances.whereabouts: Falls into Palace gardens, is arrested and brought before Queen Morgase in throne room, then escorted out
appearances.notable_actions: Falls from wall into garden injuring his head; is tended by Elayne; meets Gawyn and Galad; arrested by Tallanvor and guards; questioned by Morgase and Elaida; lies about where he is staying (says The Crown and Lion instead of The Queen's Blessing); freed by Morgase's judgment; flees Palace after being told he looks like an Aielman
appearances.demeanor: Dizzy and disoriented from head injury at first; anxious and eager to leave; frightened of Elaida and her scrutiny; tries to hide truth; panicked about being discovered; frozen by Elaida's stare; gaping and befuddled by events; running by chapter end
alliances_shown: Elayne and Gawyn protect him before Morgase

appearances.whereabouts: Palace gardens, then throne room with mother
appearances.notable_actions: Climbs down from tree after Rand falls; tends Rand's wounds with bandages and ointment; defends Rand before guards and mother; claims guest-right for him; argues with Galad; begs mother not to harm Rand; tells Rand he is handsome as parting remark
appearances.demeanor: Self-possessed, confident, compassionate, defiant of restrictions, protective of Rand, playful at the end

appearances.notable_actions: Climbs down from tree after Elayne; gives water flask for Rand's wound; explains family dynamics; defends Galad's character to Elayne; escorts Rand to gates; tells Rand he looks like an Aielman
appearances.demeanor: Protective of Elayne, friendly to Rand, respectful of mother, affectionate toward sister, worried about consequences

appearances.whereabouts: Throne room receiving reports of Logain's arrival and dealing with Rand's intrusion
appearances.notable_actions: Questions Rand's identity and origins; disciplines Elayne and Gawyn for disobedience; consults with Elaida and Gareth Bryne; decides to free Rand based on justice and assessment of his truthfulness; orders escort with courtesy
appearances.demeanor: Regal, authoritative, just, has underlying temper but keeps it controlled, maternal toward children, troubled by Elaida's Foretelling
alliances_shown: works with Elaida and Gareth Bryne as advisors

appearances.whereabouts: Throne room, sitting on stool behind throne knitting
appearances.notable_actions: Studies Rand intensely; examines his sword and skin; questions his origins; issues a Foretelling about Andor's pain and division; privately tells Rand he stands at the heart of the world's pain; wants Rand imprisoned; created green garden while crops fail elsewhere
appearances.demeanor: Outwardly placid while knitting, but with terrible concentration; becomes stern and intense when examining Rand; hungry for knowledge; calculating and suspicious; displeased when Morgase frees Rand
alliances_shown: will take Elayne to Tar Valon for training

appearances.whereabouts: Throne room at Queen's right hand
appearances.notable_actions: Steps between Rand and Queen when sword is revealed; recognizes that sword belongs with Rand despite his youth; advises temporary imprisonment of Rand; defers to Queen's judgment
appearances.demeanor: Strong, immovable, observant, practical, fair-minded, protective of Queen
alliances_shown: Morgase wishes to marry him but both are stubborn

appearances.whereabouts: Palace gardens and halls, leading arrest party and escort
appearances.notable_actions: Leads guards to arrest Rand; announces intruder to Queen; tries to take Rand's sword but Elayne invokes guest-right; escorts Rand from Palace with visible displeasure; slams sally-port after Rand
appearances.demeanor: Dutiful but resentful of being overruled by Elayne; satisfied when he has proper authority; scowling at perceived disrespect; sour when forced to show courtesy

appearances.notable_actions: Discovers Rand with Elayne and Gawyn; tells them to stand away; questions Rand's propriety; argues with Elayne about her judgment; leaves to report to guards (doing 'the right thing')
appearances.demeanor: Confident, concerned for Elayne's safety, reasonable in tone, undeterred by Elayne's scorn, dutiful

appearances.whereabouts: Being paraded through Caemlyn, viewed by crowds
appearances.notable_actions: Passed through city, viewed by Rand and others from walls; being transported to Tar Valon
appearances.demeanor: Described as dangerous even when caged

appearances.notable_actions: Appears in dream sitting at table where Moiraine and Logain had been
Wanders unconcernedly through hall weaving between staring servants

relationships.description: Morgase is Elayne's mother; disciplines her but loves her
Morgase is Gawyn's mother; disciplines and trains him
Full siblings, share same parents; close relationship, Gawyn protective
Half-siblings sharing father Taringail Damodred; Elayne hates Galad
Half-brothers sharing father Taringail Damodred; Galad has saved Gawyn's life twice
Morgase wants to marry him but neither will bend first; she makes suggestions, he obeys, but she won't command him and he won't propose
Elaida is Morgase's Aes Sedai advisor; Morgase commands her but also relies on her counsel
Gareth Bryne serves as Captain-General to Queen Morgase; trusted advisor
Elaida will take Elayne to Tar Valon for Aes Sedai training; has taught her before
Lini was Elayne's nurse; one of the few who can make Elayne obey
Elayne tends Rand's wounds, claims guest-right for him, defends him before mother, calls him handsome
Gawyn helps Rand, wishes they could have become friends, tells him he looks like an Aielman
Elaida suspects Rand is dangerous, wants him imprisoned, Foretells he stands at heart of world's pain and division
Tallanvor arrests Rand, guards him suspiciously, reluctantly escorts him with courtesy on Queen's orders
